summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Vrihaspati advising Indra on prudent kingship: prefer peace, use strategy and deception against foes, balance severity with mildness, and strike only when advantageous.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra stands with folded palms before the sage Vrihaspati, seeking counsel on how to defeat his enemies without reckless war.
A battlefield army suddenly breaks into chaotic flight like a frightened herd of deer scattering across a plain.
A cunning fowler imitates bird calls to lure unsuspecting birds into his trap, symbolizing a king deceiving his enemies.
